SkillAlign API

Enterprise Talent Intelligence & Recruitment Automation Platform

SkillAlign automates and orchestrates the full recruitment lifecycle — from job requisition creation and AI-powered candidate matching to structured interview scheduling, hiring-manager reviews, offer management, and onboarding initiation.

Authentication

All protected endpoints require a JWT Bearer token.

  1. Call POST /api/auth/login with your email and password.
  2. Copy the returned access_token.
  3. Click the Authorize 🔒 button (top-right) and enter: <your_token> (without "Bearer " prefix).
  4. All subsequent requests will include the token automatically.

JWT tokens expire after 60 minutes by default. Use POST /api/auth/refresh to obtain a fresh token without re-authenticating.

Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)

Role Description
Admin Platform super-user. Full system access.
HR Creates job requisitions, approves candidates, schedules interviews, manages offers.
Recruiter Sources candidates, screens profiles, claims candidates, manages tasks.
Candidate Self-registers, maintains own profile and resume, views own pipeline & offers.

Core API Modules

Module Description
Authentication JWT login, OTP phone login, password reset, token refresh & revocation
Users Admin-managed user provisioning (HR / Recruiter accounts)
Skills Skill master data (create / list / update / delete)
Jobs Job requisition lifecycle managed by HR
Candidates Candidate profile and self-service skill management
Candidate Resumes Async resume upload → S3 storage → text extraction → AI parsing → auto-matching
Matching Engine AI-powered candidate-job scoring with fit/skill/experience/education scores
Match Results Pipeline state management (Matched → Screened → HR Approved → Interview → Offer → Hired)
Interviews Interview scheduling, slot selection, and feedback collection
Workflow Full recruitment state machine: shortlisting → HM review → interview → offer → hire
Offers Compensation offer creation, HM approval, PDF generation, and candidate acceptance
Notifications In-app and email notification dispatch and read-state tracking
Recruitment Communication Job-level and candidate-level messaging between HR and Recruiters
Recruitment Tasks Actionable task management dispatched by HR to Recruiters
Recruiter Operations Recruiter dashboard, candidate queue, claiming, and assignment workflows
Admin Management Paginated user management, extended profiles, and hiring audit logs
System Health check and liveness probe

Response Format

All endpoints return JSON. Successful responses follow the declared response_model. Validation errors return HTTP 422 with a structured detail array. Authentication errors return HTTP 401. Authorization failures return HTTP 403.

Note: This documentation is generated directly from the live FastAPI application. The OpenAPI specification at /openapi.json is always authoritative.

Jobs

Job requisition lifecycle. HR creates and manages job postings with skill requirements and experience thresholds. Recruiters are assigned to jobs by HR.

Create a new job requisition (HR / Admin only)

HR creates a job with title, min experience, description, and required/preferred skills with weights. If status is 'active', automatic candidate matching is queued in the background. Recruiters cannot create jobs.

Authorizations:
None
Request Body schema: application/json
required
title
required
string (Title)
Description (string) or Description (null) (Description)
Department (string) or Department (null) (Department)
Client Name (string) or Client Name (null) (Client Name)
min_experience_years
number (Min Experience Years)
Default: 0
Work Mode (string) or Work Mode (null) (Work Mode)
Default: "Hybrid"
Location City (string) or Location City (null) (Location City)
Location State (string) or Location State (null) (Location State)
Location Country (string) or Location Country (null) (Location Country)
Default: "India"
Urgency (string) or Urgency (null) (Urgency)
Default: "30 days"
Shift Timing (string) or Shift Timing (null) (Shift Timing)
Default: "Day"
Travel Requirements (string) or Travel Requirements (null) (Travel Requirements)
Default: "None"
status
string (Status)
Default: "draft"
Array of objects (Skills)
Default: []

Responses

/api/jobs

HR updates job specifications and associated skills. If matching-relevant fields change (skills, experience, work mode, status), existing match results are marked stale and re-matching is queued automatically. Recruiters cannot edit job requirements.

Candidate Resumes

Async resume upload pipeline: store to S3 → extract text → AI-parse → sync skills → trigger auto-matching. Supports PDF, DOCX, and TXT.

Upload Candidate Resume (PDF, DOCX, TXT) — Async Processing

Stores the original resume to S3 immediately, then queues async processing (text extraction, parsing, skill sync, auto-matching). Returns a task_id for status polling via GET /{id}/resume/status. Processing typically completes within 5-30 seconds depending on file size.

Authorizations:
None
path Parameters
candidate_id
required
integer (Candidate Id)
Request Body schema: multipart/form-data
required
file
required
string <binary> (File)

Matching Engine

AI-powered candidate-job matching. Computes weighted fit scores across skills, experience, education, work mode preference, and location. Supports manual re-runs.

Queue matching engine for a job (Recruiter/HR/Admin)

Queues an async background matching task. Returns immediately with task status. Normal matching is triggered automatically when HR publishes/updates a job or a candidate uploads a resume. Use this endpoint for manual re-evaluation. Recruiter can trigger re-matching for any active job.

None
path Parameters
job_id
required
integer (Job Id)
query Parameters
sync
boolean (Sync)

Responses

Interviews

Interview lifecycle management: scheduling, slot-based coordination, status tracking, and feedback collection. Candidate receives email notification on scheduling.

Schedule an interview (HR Only)

HR schedules an interview for a candidate, transitions match status to 'interview_scheduled', and dispatches candidate notification via SendGrid and in-app alert.

Authorizations:
None
Request Body schema: application/json
required
match_result_id
required
integer (Match Result Id)
Interview Date (string) or Interview Date (null) (Interview Date)
interview_type
string (Interview Type)
Default: "technical"
Meeting Link (string) or Meeting Link (null) (Meeting Link)
Interview Mode (string) or Interview Mode (null) (Interview Mode)
Default: "online"
Scheduled End (string) or Scheduled End (null) (Scheduled End)
Feedback (string) or Feedback (null) (Feedback)
status
string (Status)
Default: "scheduled"
send_notification
boolean (Send Notification)
Default: true

Responses

HM: Submit per-round feedback and GO/PASS/NO-GO decision

HM submits per-round feedback with PASS/GO/NO_GO recommendation.

  • PASS: Intermediate round passed, next round to be scheduled.
  • GO: Final round approved, pipeline advances to COMPENSATION_DISCUSSION.
  • NO_GO: Terminates the pipeline.
Authorizations:
None
path Parameters
interview_id
required
integer (Interview Id)
query Parameters
recommendation
required
string (Recommendation)

PASS | GO | NO_GO

is_final_round
boolean (Is Final Round)
Default: false

True if this is the final configured round

Communication Rating (integer) or Communication Rating (null) (Communication Rating)
Problem Solving Rating (integer) or Problem Solving Rating (null) (Problem Solving Rating)

Overall Rating (integer) or Overall Rating (null) (Overall Rating)
Comments (string) or Comments (null) (Comments)

Admin Management

Admin-only endpoints for paginated user management with search and filters, extended user detail views, user activation toggle, account deletion, and comprehensive hiring audit logs.

List all users with pagination, search, and filters (Admin only)

Returns a paginated list of all users. Supports server-side filtering by role, status (active/deactivated), and search by name or email. Response includes pagination metadata.

Authorizations:
None
query Parameters
page
integer (Page) >= 1
Default: 1

Page number (1-indexed)

page_size
integer (Page Size) [ 1 .. 100 ]
Default: 20

Results per page (max 100)

Search (string) or Search (null) (Search)

Search by name or email (partial match)

Role (string) or Role (null) (Role)

Filter by role name: Admin, HR, Recruiter, Candidate

Status (string) or Status (null) (Status)

Filter by status: active, deactivated

/api/admin/users
